payload.title: P6 Administration > Policies > Writing guidelines
payload.description:
What: admins edit writing guidelines in the newsroom, beside Visual style (PPY-6d878b), with the same layout. Fulfils the writing-guidelines part of PPY-90e312.

Files:
- components/writing-guidelines-admin-panel.tsx, lib/guidelines/writing-guidelines-admin.ts (client over guidelinesRead/guidelinesWrite)
- components/topic-steering-workspace.tsx: nav entry under Policies; move the section editor's Visual Guidance box to the section's Visual style tab
- features/newsroom-writing-guidelines-admin.feature + steps; scripts/test-writing-guidelines-admin.ts

Acceptance checks:
- Site tab and one tab per section; each field labelled in text with its source (Site / This section / Locked by site), never colour alone.
- History lists who, when, why; diff between two versions; save requires a reason.
- Exemplars picked from published Stories; derived checks listed with a link to Editorial checks.
- Lucide icons only, flat backgrounds, no borders; editors see a read-only view.

Gherkin scenarios:
- An admin edits the site's writing guidelines and sees a new version in history
- An admin adds a section override and sees which fields come from the site
- A locked field cannot be changed on a section tab
- An editor sees the guidelines read-only
- Saving without a reason is not possible
- An admin picks a published Story as a voice example

Design: docs/plans/guidelines-as-data.md. Gherkin specs are required and ship in the same PR. Text lives in S3, never inline in DynamoDB; no new GSI; no subscriptions. Style and voice wording is data, never code.
